summary: Build BI governance and a Centre of Excellence with practical templates, controls, and roadmap tools. Enquire now.
lede: Self-service BI governance sets practical rules for trusted dashboards, datasets and metrics while supporting business-user reporting. Designed for BI managers, administrators, data governance specialists, analytics leads and reporting managers, this course helps structure governance operations and reduce inconsistent reporting. Learners assess current practices, define KPI ownership and access controls, govern semantic models and changes, and shape a Centre of Excellence with clear roles and support processes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage or influence self-service BI governance, dashboard standards, and Centre of Excellence operations.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of business intelligence concepts, dashboard reporting, and basic data governance principles. Experience with self-service BI environments, especially Power BI or comparable analytics platforms, is recommended. No coding/programming is required for completion, but you should be comfortable reviewing datasets, measures, permissions, and report structures. Advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level, with governance design and Centre of Excellence planning covered through practical templates and case-based exercises.
